name: todo-vault-workspace
description: Local-first, Jira-shaped task vault, plus the desktop app over it

scripts.dev: npm run build -w todo-vault && npm run dev -w @todo-vault/desktop

//allowScripts: npm 11.16+ blocks dependency install scripts until they are decided here (RFC npm/rfcs#868). esbuild's postinstall is denied rather than allowed: the binary arrives as the @esbuild/<platform> optional dependency, so esbuild loads, transforms and runs its CLI shim with the script blocked. Bare name rather than a pinned version, so a vite or electron-vite bump does not bring the warning back. Must stay in the ROOT package.json — npm ignores this field in a workspace.
